utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Mara! I’m hearing the repair drive is tentatively Saturday around 10 at the community room by the laundromat, but I’m still waiting on Faye’s clearer list of who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—that matches what I’ve heard, but let’s keep Saturday at 10 tentative until Faye confirms the tool list. I’m checking with the organizers today and will send the confirmed details around once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll keep telling folks it’s tentative for now and wait for your confirmed details before I pass anything along too firmly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Jules, quick version: Rosa’s coordinating it, and I told her I can do two hours wherever it’s easiest—probably coffee or check-in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Bo — Saturday late morning is the window that seems to work, so I’ll pass along that you’re good for two hours at coffee or check-in when I send the details around today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Jules — just send me the exact time once Rosa locks it in, and I’ll show up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, quick update while I’m out: we’re still short on tables, a few tool donations, and a couple setup volunteers, but otherwise the repair drive seems on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira — when you say on track, is Saturday at 9 at Eli’s place confirmed? If so, I can help check who’s bringing tables, tools, and setup help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday is confirmed, but I’ve heard late morning rather than 9, so let me double-check Eli’s exact start time before you rally people.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning, about 10 to 1, for the repair drive; would you be able to help or bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I can help Saturday 10 to 1. Gus is bringing screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set, so I’ll bring labels, tape, and a signup sheet unless you need something else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be perfect, Leo — labels, tape, and a signup sheet will really help keep things organized. I’ll add you to the list for Saturday 10 to 1 and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Pia — I’m already covering the Saturday 10–12 intake table and bringing masking tape, but I’m happy to help with anything else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — that helps, but I’d still want the exact drop-off spot and who’s coordinating the intake table before I point anyone your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good call, Pia — I know Leo’s coordinating the intake table, but I’ll confirm the exact drop-off spot with him before you send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Vik, I’m glad you asked—repair drive details are still a bit fuzzy in my head, so please don’t take the time from me as firm until I check the flyer or Marta.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Oren — I won’t repeat any time as firm yet. I’m waiting on Noah and Rosa for the final time, location, and volunteer needs, and I’ll share the clean version once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that’s exactly the sort of clear version I need, because my notes have started arguing with each other. I’ll hold off until you hear from Noah and Rosa, or until I can check the flyer or Marta.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit behind as usual, but I’m checking with Cleo on the confirmed repair list and who’s keeping the spending ledger before we add anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane—check with Cleo first, and don’t add anything until we have the confirmed list and know who has the ledger. I’ll keep Saturday at 9 on my notes unless Marta tells us otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works, Eli—I'll hold off on adding anything and circle back once Cleo confirms the list and ledger.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hi Nell, I’m happy to lend a few tools or help out at the repair drive—just let me know what’s still missing, especially if you need a drill or socket set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on the full details from Quinn or Jules, but a drill or socket set sounds like exactly the kind of thing they may need. I can pass that along once I know who’s collecting tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell—just point me to whoever’s collecting once you hear, and I’ll set aside the drill and socket set for them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, before I commit to helping with the repair drive, do you know which repairs are confirmed in writing and who’s keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Hana, I’m not totally sure yet—I’ve only heard about tables, tools, and setup volunteers. I’ll ask who has the written repair list and ledger, then get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—I appreciate you checking instead of guessing. I’ll wait for that written repair list and ledger name before I take on a task.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, I’m tracking supplies for the repair drive before we buy anything—so far we’ve got tape, gloves, spare parts, maybe tools or extra wood, plus Gus can lend some tools. Do you know who’s writing the repair list or keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I don’t have the confirmed list or ledger person yet—Tess is waiting on Faye’s clearer details, and Noah’s checking with Vik, so I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll hold off on buying anything and mark Tess/Faye and Noah/Vik as pending for the repair list and ledger. Let me know as soon as one of them confirms so I can update the supply sheet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Opal, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details—right now it sounds like the leaky gutters by the community room and a few porch steps are first on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — do we know which exact spot we’re using first, and has Marta confirmed the time yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet—I’m still waiting on Marta to confirm the time and the exact starting spot. I’ll check in and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got a few hand tools set aside — pliers, a wrench set, and a couple screwdrivers. I can leave them by the back door tomorrow morning if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, Uli—thank you. Since the drive moved to Sunday at the community center, could you label the bag with your name and I’ll make sure someone picks it up or tells you where to drop it there?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll label the bag with my name and leave it by the back door tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once you have the exact time and drop-off spot, I can see if I’m able to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Pia — I’m confirming the time and drop-off spot with the organizers now, and I’ll let you know today before we count you in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate that. Once those details are confirmed, I can decide what I can realistically take on without causing confusion.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Vik, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details — do you know the time, location, or what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet — I’m still waiting on Noah to confirm the time, location, and what needs fixing first. Once he does, I’ll pass it along around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — just let me know when Noah confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, before I promise help with the repair drive, do you know if Rosa has a written repair list yet and who’s officially keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t know for sure yet whether Rosa has the written list or who’s holding the ledger, so I’ll check with her before you commit. I’m sending details to both groups today, and I’ll include that once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—please send me only the confirmed list and ledger name once Rosa verifies them, and I’ll hold off on committing until then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo! So far it’s only tentative: Opal says the repair drive’s looking like 10 Saturday in the community room by the laundromat, but we’re still waiting on Marta or the flyer to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks Tess — I’ll treat 10 Saturday at the community room as tentative and wait for Marta or the flyer before I tell anyone it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Bo — I’ll keep asking around on who’s bringing tools too, and I’ll holler as soon as Marta or the flyer makes it official.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—I’ve got the drill and socket set marked to come back that evening. Can you label your tools and bring them by Saturday around 10?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll label everything and bring the drill, socket set, and a few extras by Saturday around 10.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Gus. Who’s writing the repair list and who’s keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m just firming up the time and drop-off details now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve got it noted as Sunday at the community center. Send me the time and drop-off details when you’ve got them, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Opal — I’ll send the confirmed time and drop-off spot as soon as I have them, and I’m keeping the roster organized in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly hand tools—pliers, a wrench set, and a couple screwdrivers. I can leave them by the back door tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’s great, Uli—thanks. I’ll tell Ira you’ve got hand tools for tomorrow morning, and I’ll double-check where she wants drop-offs so they don’t sit in the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll have them tucked by the back door early, and if Ira wants them somewhere else just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, but I’m still nailing down the exact drop-off time and location—do you know any confirmed details yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve heard Saturday late morning is the plan, but I don’t want to guess on the exact drop-off spot yet. Jules is sending details around today, so I’ll pass them to you as soon as I see them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Ira—send me Jules’s details when they land, and I’ll hold off on telling Pia and Nell anything exact until then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Sam, the repair drive is still coming together—Saturday morning is the plan, but please check the flyer or Marta for the exact time before you spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Oren — I’ll double-check the flyer or ask Marta before I share the time with anyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam—I appreciate that. I’ll try to check the sign-up sheet too, before my memory turns it into three different Saturdays.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Faye, I’m keeping the supply list for the repair drive—so far we’ve got tape, gloves, spare parts, and Gus’s tools, but I still need to know who’s writing the repair list and keeping the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still settling the names, but I’ll confirm who’s writing the repair list and who’s keeping the ledger before anyone brings money.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye—I’ll hold off on any purchases until you confirm those names, and I’ll keep Gus’s borrowed tools marked with the drill and socket set due back that evening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we actually set on the repair drive yet, Leo? If you’ve got the latest list, I can check who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Almost set. Gus is bringing screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set he needs back that evening; I’m still checking the final repair list and volunteer coverage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Almost set isn’t quite confirmed, then — can you send me the final repair list once you’ve checked it? I’ll hold off telling folks who’s covering what until we know for sure.
